Ajay Diwan reveals to Gokuldham members why goons are after him: he is in Mumbai to sell a 200-year-old, 90-carat royal heirloom ruby valued at ₹10 crore. To prove it's authentic, he turns off the lights to showcase its glow and presents an international certification.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
